paragraphs.source_en: I saw that she wished me to appeal to his sympathies by every means in my power. She was weeping freely. I was extraordinarily touched. I felt indignant at Strickland’s cold cruelty, and I promised to do all I could to bring him back. I agreed to go over on the next day but one, and to stay in Paris till I had achieved something. Then, as it was growing late and we were both exhausted by so much emotion, I left her.

units.source_en: I saw that she wished me to appeal to his sympathies by every means in my power.
She was weeping freely.
I was extraordinarily touched.
I felt indignant at Strickland’s cold cruelty, and I promised to do all I could to bring him back.
I agreed to go over on the next day but one, and to stay in Paris till I had achieved something.
Then, as it was growing late and we were both exhausted by so much emotion, I left her.
